static_code_assessment.weights: Exact Fraction design follows category/physical-instance metadata; group indices and old source_objects ordinal map match protocol.
static_code_assessment.weak_state_selection: 11 named clean/low states selected from prior source bank. Shape photo,state,feature=(540,11,512); reshape aligns np.repeat labels and q(r)*p(s).
static_code_assessment.normalization: Old mean/scalar scale is inverted, then fixed sqrt512 applied; all source states checked at squared norm512.
static_code_assessment.solver: 22 separate zero-initialized float64 CPU heads; same CE+L2, LBFGS caps and independent NumPy objective/gradient check <=1e-5.
static_code_assessment.access_order: Only selected source state members are decoded until all heads and source diagnostics saved and hashed in training-freeze.json. development_seen decoded afterwards. No evaluation-features archive path is used.
static_code_assessment.primary: Per-object36-view means, five fixed configuration interaction mean, then balanced10-object mean. Positive J means weak is relatively worse under B.
static_code_assessment.resampling: All1024 ordered within-class size2-with-replacement selections enumerated. Arms/configurations remain paired; no view pseudo-replication.
static_code_assessment.failure: Measurement gate separated from effect gates. No alpha/C/strength/metric/stop tuning branch; exclusive JSON writes stop incidental reruns.
static_code_assessment.budget: 120 scientific seconds and Mac2GiB peakRSS checked, single-threadTorch. Need launcher BLAS environment limits as protocol requires.

scope_notes: Static review and ZIP central directory only; no NPY payload, model, training, development value or final array read.
Cached feature row association is supported by original extraction/encoding order and unchanged input SHA, not an independent re-encoding.
Kish concentration is matched between B/S, but qS induces object-by-condition associations; no unique shortcut mechanism inferred.
All50objects consumed. Interval is conditional object stability; positive screen would still need new independent-object confirmation.
Capability failure may leave computed effect numbers in results; interpretation must prioritize gates and not call this a scientific effect falsification.
next_authorized_independent_step: After parent runs once, recompute only from new frozen heads/source states and development_seen/new development outputs, with no training and no final archive access.
